meta.theme_name_note: Renamed by the user directly in style.css on 2026-08-27 (was 'Hex'). Admin UI reads the name live via wp_get_theme() rather than hardcoding it, so further renames need no code change.
meta.type: WordPress theme (classic PHP templates, not a block/FSE theme)
meta.purpose: Standalone custom WordPress theme with exactly three selectable page templates (Default, Full Width, Canvas), a GitHub-based self-updater, a child-theme installer (fetches + validates + installs from GitHub, does not auto-generate) with its own fully independent GitHub self-updater, a YOOtheme-Pro-scale admin-configurable design-token system (Theme Options: 173 fields / 13 groups — typography incl. line-height/letter-spacing/weight/margin, spacing, a 15-color palette, buttons with variants, forms, cards, sections, global radius, tables, alerts, badges, navigation, icons — applied via runtime CSS custom properties, no rebuild needed, gated on an active child theme, tabbed admin UI), and a Tailwind-CSS-styled theme management admin dashboard carrying the Hexnity brand (logo + color palette). Front end uses Tailwind CSS + Animate.css but a neutral palette — no brand color/logo there, by explicit user instruction.
meta.boundary: All work is strictly confined to this theme directory. See claude.md.

docs.claude.md: Base file. Boundaries, rules, and read-order instructions. Always read first.
docs.action-map.json: Chronological log of every action taken against a user requirement.
docs.project.json: This file. Structure/files/functions index — read here before opening real files.
docs.features/: One md file per complete feature, updated whenever that feature changes.
docs.knoladge/: Implementation notes, decisions, and documented failures/errors, kept for reuse.
docs.github.md: Reference doc (from a prior/related project) describing a GitHub-based self-updater mechanism. This theme's own updater (inc/updater.php) follows its architecture but is admin-configured rather than hardcoded — see features/github-updater.md.
docs.README.md: Public-facing project readme: features, requirements, dev setup, testing/linting/build commands, license.
docs.LICENSE: Full GPLv2 (or later) license text, matching style.css's License field.

functions: hex_enqueue_assets() — hooked to wp_enqueue_scripts. Enqueues hex-style (style.css header), hex-animate (animate.min.css), hex-tailwind (tailwind.css), hex-navigation (navigation.js).

Its 'google_font' render case now calls hex_resolve_google_font_field_selection() to determine the selected <option> (added 2026-08-29, name-only fallback for hand-edited values).
functions: hex_register_update_settings() -- hooked to admin_init.
hex_sanitize_github_repo( $value ) -- validates owner/repo format, records a settings error and returns '' if invalid.
hex_sanitize_github_branch( $value ) -- trim + sanitize_text_field().
hex_render_github_repo_field() / hex_render_github_branch_field() / hex_render_activation_key_field().
hex_register_child_theme_settings() -- hooked to admin_init. Separate settings group 'hex_child_updates'.

hex_render_child_github_repo_field() / hex_render_child_github_branch_field() / hex_render_child_activation_key_field().

hex_render_style_field( $args ) -- generic field renderer for all 7 field types (color-swatch+text / weight select / shadow-preset select / font text with list="hex-google-fonts-list" / length+number+custom text).
hex_style_field_placeholder_for_type( $type ) -- the placeholder hint for a plain-text field type.
hex_render_style_fields( $fields ) -- renders one label+input pair per already-filtered schema key=>field array; shared body used by both branches of hex_render_style_group_fields().

hex_render_style_group_fields( $group ) -- renders every hex_get_effective_style_schema() field belonging to one group, bucketed by each field's optional 'subgroup' label. A group with 2+ distinct subgroups (Typography's H1-H6/Body/Lead/.../Fonts & Links, Buttons' variants, Alerts'/Badges' states, Sections' Backgrounds/Padding) renders as a <details>/<summary> accordion, one item per subgroup, only the first open by default. A group with 0-1 subgroups (colors, spacing, forms, cards, global, tables, icons, custom) renders exactly as before -- one flat two-column grid.
hex_render_google_fonts_field() -- the 'Google Fonts' repeater (one row per URL) + resolved-family chip list, rendered once at the top of the Typography panel only.

inc/admin/menu.php.purpose: Registers the top-level admin menu (fixed label 'Hexnity WP' — deliberately NOT wp_get_theme()->get('Name') per user request, icon = plain 'dashicons-art') + Dashboard/Updates/About/Child Theme/Theme Options submenus; scopes tailwind-admin.css/admin.js to just these screens.

hex_enqueue_admin_assets( $hook ) — hooked to admin_enqueue_scripts.

inc/admin/partials.php.purpose: Shared app-shell dashboard chrome for all five admin pages: hex_render_admin_shell_start( $active, $title, $description )/hex_render_admin_shell_end() render a persistent dark hexnity-branded sidebar (logo, 5-item icon nav, version footer) plus an equally dark content pane (bg-gray-950/900) with its own header bar. hex_render_admin_icon() prints one of a fixed set of inline SVGs built from plain shapes (rect/circle/line, not copied path data). hex_render_admin_stat_tile() is the icon+value+label tile used in the Dashboard's stat row (indigo icon chip). hex_render_admin_submit_button() renders a .hex-btn.hex-btn-primary submit button in place of WP core's submit_button(), which is styled for a light theme. General interactive accent is Tailwind's indigo scale, not hexnity-* (user: 'u dont need to strict with logo colors' — see knoladge/admin-dark-theme-components.md). Nav active/inactive text colors use Tailwind's ! important-modifier since WP core's unlayered admin CSS otherwise beats layered Tailwind utilities — see knoladge/tailwind-cascade-layers-vs-wp-admin.md.

hex_render_admin_icon( $name, $classes )
hex_render_admin_shell_start( $active, $title, $description )
hex_render_admin_shell_end()
hex_render_admin_stat_tile( $icon, $value, $label )
hex_render_admin_submit_button( $label, $disabled )

inc/admin/handlers.php.purpose: admin-post.php handlers for the Updates, Child Theme, and Theme Options pages' actions. hex_handle_save_style_options() no longer saves a separate hex_google_fonts_urls option (removed 2026-08-29 along with the free-text Google Fonts picker) -- Font Library values save through the normal schema-driven token pipeline like every other field.
functions: hex_handle_check_updates() -- admin_post_hex_check_updates.
hex_handle_perform_update() -- admin_post_hex_perform_update.
hex_handle_install_child_theme() -- admin_post_hex_install_child_theme.
hex_handle_check_child_updates() -- admin_post_hex_check_child_updates.
hex_handle_perform_child_update() -- admin_post_hex_perform_child_update.

hex_handle_save_style_options() -- admin_post_hex_save_style_options. Hard-checks hex_is_child_theme_active() server-side, sanitizes every submitted design token + the Google Fonts field, rewrites theme-options.css via WP_Filesystem, reports rejected fields via transient. See knoladge/child-theme-css-token-architecture.md.

hex_handle_reset_style_group() -- admin_post_hex_reset_style_group. A nonce-protected GET link (not a form post -- it lives inside the page's one main <form>), used by the 'Reset to Defaults' link in each Theme Options tab panel header. Resets only the requested group's fields to their hex_get_style_schema() defaults via hex_reset_style_group_tokens() (inc/style-settings.php), leaving every other group's saved values untouched. This is the only way for a site that already saved a field once to pick up a later PHP-side default change (e.g. the fluid-typography mobile/desktop defaults) -- a changed default never retroactively overrides an already-saved value. See knoladge/fluid-typography-clamp.md.

inc/admin/page-dashboard.php.purpose: Dashboard page render: a 4-tile stat row (theme version, page template count, effective style-settings count incl. auto-detected custom tokens, child-theme active state) via hex_render_admin_stat_tile(), then the existing Tailwind card grid (updates status, page templates, nav menus, quick links).

inc/admin/page-updates.php.purpose: Updates page render (Tailwind cards): settings form + Check Now / Check & Update Now buttons + last-run log.

inc/admin/page-about.php.purpose: About page render (Tailwind definition list): theme metadata straight from wp_get_theme().

inc/admin/page-child-theme.php.purpose: Child Theme page render: repo/branch/token settings form, status card (Activated / Installed-not-active / none, per hex_is_child_theme_active()), 'Fetch & Install Child Theme' button (hidden while active), Check/Update buttons.

inc/admin/page-theme-options.php.purpose: Theme Options page render, inside the shared shell: left-category tab nav (12 groups + an auto-appearing 'Custom Tokens' tab) + right detail panel with card-style panel headers (JS-driven, assets/js/admin.js), all fields wrapped in a <fieldset disabled> unless hex_is_child_theme_active(), an amber notice + link to Child Theme when disabled, a transient-based save-result message (get_transient('hex_theme_options_log')), and a sticky bottom save bar. Form posts to admin-post.php (hex_handle_save_style_options()), not options.php. Field layout inside each tab panel is fully owned by hex_render_style_group_fields() (inc/admin/settings.php) -- this file no longer wraps its output in a grid div, since that function renders either a flat grid or an accordion depending on the group. Each panel header also carries a per-group 'Reset to Defaults' link (nonce-protected GET to admin-post.php?action=hex_reset_style_group, confirm() guarded, hidden when no child theme active) -- a plain link rather than a nested <form>, since the whole page is already one <form>; see hex_handle_reset_style_group() (inc/admin/handlers.php). No longer renders a separate Google Fonts picker block above the Typography panel's fields (hex_render_google_fonts_field()/hex_render_google_fonts_datalist() calls removed 2026-08-29).

inc/child-theme.php.purpose: Fetches, validates (Template: header must match this theme), and installs a child theme from GitHub — not auto-generated — plus its own independent GitHub self-updater. See features/child-theme.md for full detail.
functions: hex_fetch_remote_child_style_css( $repo, $branch ) — wp_remote_get()s raw.githubusercontent.com/{repo}/{branch}/style.css, parses Theme Name:/Template: headers.
hex_validate_child_theme_repo( $repo, $branch ) — rejects unless the fetched Template: matches get_template().

hex_install_child_theme_from_repo( $repo, $branch ) — validates, then installs the branch zip via Theme_Upgrader->install(), renaming the extracted {repo}-{branch}/ folder via an upgrader_source_selection filter.

hex_get_child_theme_slug() — prefers the LIVE active child (is_child_theme() ? get_stylesheet() : ...) over the tracked hex_child_theme_slug option, so any child of this theme is detected regardless of how it was installed (fixed a real bug where a manually-activated child theme wasn't recognized).
hex_get_child_github_repo() / hex_get_child_github_branch() / hex_get_child_activation_key() — thin get_option() wrappers, separate option names from the parent's.
hex_is_child_theme_active() — is_child_theme() directly; drives the admin page's Install-vs-Activated UI states.
hex_get_child_update_checker() — separate PucFactory instance pointed at the child's own style.css (via wp_get_theme($slug), works whether or not the child is active).
hex_check_for_child_theme_update() / hex_perform_child_theme_update() — mirror the parent's equivalents, operating on the child.

inc/style-settings.php.purpose: The admin-configurable design-token schema -- 173 fields across 13 groups (typography/spacing/colors/buttons/forms/cards/sections/global/tables/alerts/badges/nav/icons) -- plus auto-discovery of any extra '--hex-*' custom properties a child theme hand-adds, and the CSS-file builder + front-end enqueue. Values are stored in a CSS file inside the active child theme (theme-options.css), not the database. Every typography size field (H1-H6 + body/lead/large/small/meta) is still a mobile/desktop pair, but the derived '--hex-{key}-size' is now a FLAT copy of the desktop value, never a clamp() -- fluid interpolation was removed from this generator per explicit user request; a separate, unrelated static CSS layer (.hex-h1...hex-meta in site-theme.css) is fluid instead, via its own single shared clamp() with hardcoded (non-Theme-Options) breakpoints. See hex_get_fluid_size_pairs()/hex_build_fluid_clamp() and knoladge/fluid-typography-clamp.md for the full history. See knoladge/child-theme-css-token-architecture.md and features/design-system.md for full detail. Loaded unconditionally -- the front end needs hex_enqueue_child_theme_tokens() on every request. Added 2026-08-29: four 'google_font'-type Font Library schema fields (font_heading/font_body/font_accent/font_mono, subgroup 'Font Library', default ''), hex_sanitize_style_google_font_slot() (empty-is-valid, otherwise must exactly match a hex_get_common_google_fonts() stack), and hex_build_style_tokens_css() treats 'google_font' the same as 'font' (skips an unset/unsafe value, emits a valid one verbatim). The older body_font_family/heading_font_family free-text fields were removed the same day once the Font Library became the theme's sole font-selection mechanism (see knoladge/google-fonts-picker.md). hex_build_style_tokens_css() now groups its output into commented sections (one per schema group, in hex_get_style_groups() canonical order, skipping empty groups) instead of one flat declaration list -- added 2026-08-29 per explicit user request ('add comments to theme options and separate them in code').
functions: hex_get_style_schema() -- the static base schema, built with loops for repetitive families (heading levels, button/alert/badge variants) rather than ~150 hand-written literals. Every heading/text-style size is a {key}_size_mobile/{key}_size_desktop pair, not a single {key}_size field -- each pair ships with genuinely different mobile/desktop defaults (desktop matches the pre-1.5.6 static size, mobile a proportionally smaller value) so every field is fluid out of the box; hex_build_fluid_clamp() would otherwise silently collapse an equal-defaults pair to a flat value. See knoladge/fluid-typography-clamp.md.
hex_get_style_groups() -- the 13 static group labels in display order.
hex_style_humanize_key( $key ) -- snake_case -> Title Case, used to auto-label loop-built and auto-detected fields.
hex_get_shadow_presets() -- fixed keyword -> real box-shadow CSS map (none/sm/md/lg/xl); the CSS itself is NOT admin-editable, only which preset applies.
hex_style_field_name( $key ) / hex_style_css_var_name( $key ) -- naming transforms (hex_style_{key} form field name/id, --hex-{key with hyphens} CSS var).
hex_style_tokens_file_path() -- get_stylesheet_directory() . '/theme-options.css', the active child theme's token file.
hex_parse_style_tokens_css( $css ) -- pure regex parser: extracts every --hex-{key}: {value}; declaration from a CSS string.
hex_get_child_theme_tokens() -- reads + parses the active child theme's file (empty array if no child theme active or file doesn't exist); deliberately not cached, see the knoladge doc for why.
hex_guess_style_type( $value ) -- pure; guesses color/length/number/font/custom for an auto-detected token, never weight/shadow (closed enumerations).

hex_merge_style_schema_with_tokens( $schema, $tokens ) -- pure; adds a 'custom'-group entry for every file token not already in the schema, EXCEPT a hex_get_fluid_size_pairs() output key (e.g. 'h1_size') -- those are derived-only and always get overwritten by hex_build_style_tokens_css(), so exposing one as an editable custom field would silently discard any edit on the next save. See knoladge/fluid-typography-clamp.md.

hex_get_effective_style_schema() / hex_get_effective_style_groups() / hex_get_effective_style_values() -- the static schema/groups merged with auto-detected tokens; what the admin UI and save handler actually use.
hex_get_style_value( $key ) -- resolves via the effective schema + the child theme's file, falling back to the schema default.

hex_reset_style_group_tokens( $group, $schema, $current ) -- pure; returns $current with every field belonging to $group replaced by its schema default, every other group's value untouched. Used by hex_handle_reset_style_group() (inc/admin/handlers.php) for the per-tab 'Reset to Defaults' link -- the only way an already-saved site picks up a later default change.
hex_is_safe_style_value( $value ) / hex_is_safe_font_value( $value ) -- output-time injection defenses re-checked when the file is rebuilt.

hex_get_fluid_size_pairs() -- pure; maps each derived '{key}_size' output var (e.g. 'h1_size') to its '{key}_size_mobile'/'{key}_size_desktop' schema-key pair, for every heading level and body-level text style.

hex_build_fluid_clamp( $mobile, $desktop, $mobile_bp, $desktop_bp ) -- pure; builds the clamp(mobile, calc(interpolation), desktop) expression, collapsing to a flat value when mobile===desktop and falling back to desktop when the two breakpoints are equal (avoids a division by zero). No longer called by hex_build_style_tokens_css() (see above) -- left defined and unit-tested as a pure, self-contained utility.

hex_build_style_tokens_css( $tokens, $schema ) -- pure; builds the full theme-options.css file contents (shadow-keyword resolution, per-type re-validation, custom-type check), then appends one derived '--hex-{key}-size' declaration per hex_get_fluid_size_pairs() entry as a FLAT COPY of that pair's desktop value (never a clamp() -- removed per explicit user request; see knoladge/fluid-typography-clamp.md) -- the raw mobile/desktop values are also written as their own '--hex-{key}-size-mobile'/'-desktop' vars, and any leftover flat '{key}_size' token from before the pair existed is never written verbatim.
hex_enqueue_child_theme_tokens() -- hooked wp_enqueue_scripts; enqueues the active child theme's theme-options.css file directly (filemtime()-versioned) when it exists.

hex_sanitize_style_length() / hex_sanitize_style_number() / hex_sanitize_style_color() / hex_sanitize_style_weight() / hex_sanitize_style_shadow() / hex_sanitize_style_font() / hex_sanitize_style_custom() -- one per field type, pure: sanitized value or null on failure.
hex_sanitize_submitted_style_tokens( $submitted, $schema, $current ) -- pure; sanitizes a full submission, falling back to current values and reporting rejected field labels.
hex_style_sanitize_callback_for_type( $type ) -- maps a schema field type (incl. 'custom') to its sanitize callback function name.

header.php.purpose: Opens <html>/<body>, skip link, site branding (text-large fallback title), primary nav. Neutral Tailwind styling (gray scale, no logo/brand color — see features/brand-styling.md). Used by every template except template-canvas.php.

footer.php.purpose: Footer widgets, footer nav, site-info/copyright (text-small), closes <body>/<html>. Neutral Tailwind styling. Used by every template except template-canvas.php.

index.php.purpose: Fallback loop template for any query without a more specific template.

page.php.purpose: Implicit default page template (no explicit template selected). Renders template-parts/content-page.php.

single.php.purpose: Single post template: content, comments, post navigation.

archive.php.purpose: Category/tag/date/author archive listing. Title uses text-h1 (design-token, see features/design-system.md).

search.php.purpose: Search results listing. Title uses text-h1.

404.php.purpose: Not Found page with a search form. Title uses text-h1 (weight/letter-spacing now via base h1{} rule); card uses .card component.

comments.php.purpose: Comment list + comment form, included via comments_template(). Comments title uses text-h3; 'closed' notice uses text-small.

template-default.php.purpose: Template Name: Default. Explicitly selectable equivalent of page.php — header, title, content, footer.

template-full-width.php.purpose: Template Name: Full Width. Header/footer shown, title and max-width constraint suppressed.

template-canvas.php.purpose: Template Name: Canvas. No header, no footer, no title — content only, own minimal <html> shell.

template-parts/content.php.purpose: Post entry rendering for loop contexts (index/archive/search). Uses .card component; title text-h1 (singular)/text-h2 (list item, hover:text-site-primary), meta/footer text-small, animate__fadeIn.

template-parts/content-none.php.purpose: Empty-result state, incl. search form when the query was a search. Title text-h2; card uses .card component.

template-parts/content-page.php.purpose: Page title (text-h1, conditional on hex_should_show_title()) + content ('prose' typography — headings inside also respond to Theme Options via site-theme.css's .prose overrides). Shared by page.php and template-default.php.

assets/js/navigation.js.purpose: Accessible mobile menu toggle: toggles Tailwind hidden/flex classes on #site-navigation ul.

assets/js/admin.js.purpose: Confirm-dialog guard on the 'Check & Update Now' form, plus Theme Options tab switching and color-swatch/hex-text sync. Previously also had a Google Fonts URL-paste repeater IIFE (row add/remove, live family-name mirroring into a shared <datalist>) -- removed 2026-08-29 along with the free-text picker it supported (~135 lines deleted).

assets/css/src/theme.css.purpose: hexnity-{50..900} Tailwind v4 @theme color tokens, extracted from the real logo pixel color #009688 (Material Teal 500). Imported only by admin.css.

assets/css/src/front.css.purpose: Front-end Tailwind entry: full Tailwind incl. Preflight + @tailwindcss/typography, and imports ./site-theme.css (restored here 2026-08-29 after a since-reversed 2026-08-28 move to the child theme). Does NOT import theme.css — front end has no brand color.

assets/css/src/admin.css.purpose: Admin Tailwind entry: tailwindcss/theme + tailwindcss/utilities only (no Preflight, so it doesn't reset the rest of wp-admin's chrome) + theme.css, plus a @layer components block of admin-only UI components (.hex-btn/-primary/-secondary/-danger, .hex-field, .hex-color-swatch, .hex-label) and dark-theme restyles for WP-core-rendered markup we don't control classes on (.form-table, .notice, .description). Several rules use Tailwind's ! important-modifier since WP core's own admin CSS is unlayered — see knoladge/admin-dark-theme-components.md.

assets/css/tailwind.css.purpose: Compiled front-end CSS (npm run build:css:front). Shipped/committed like inc/lib — WordPress can't run the npm build in production.

assets/css/tailwind-admin.css.purpose: Compiled admin CSS (npm run build:css:admin). Shipped/committed.

assets/vendor/animate.min.css.purpose: Vendored Animate.css (from npm package, copied — same pattern as inc/lib/plugin-update-checker/). Front-end only.

assets/images/hexnity-dark.png.purpose: The user's actual logo (downloaded from https://hexnity.com/images/hexnity-dark.png). White wordmark — needs a dark background. Admin-only usage: the dashboard sidebar (h-11, bumped from h-7 per user request 'make the logo little bigger'). The wp-admin sidebar menu icon uses a plain dashicon instead, not this image (a cropped-mark version was tried and removed per user request).

inc/google-fonts.php.purpose: The Font Library: four dropdown-only Theme Options fields (font_heading/font_body/font_accent/font_mono), backed by hex_get_common_google_fonts() -- a curated, hardcoded list of ~40 common Google Fonts (name/category/CSS stack/weights). hex_get_font_library_selection() resolves the four saved slots to real font-list entries; hex_build_font_library_url() (pure) builds one combined, deduped fonts.googleapis.com URL; hex_enqueue_font_library() enqueues it; hex_google_fonts_resource_hints() adds preconnect hints when a font is selected. This theme previously also had a free-text 'paste a Google Fonts embed link' picker (repeater UI, <datalist>, hex_google_fonts_urls option) feeding body_font_family/heading_font_family -- removed entirely 2026-08-29 per explicit user request ('keep only that option and remove all other font options') once the Font Library covered the same need with no risk of an unloaded/typo'd font. See knoladge/google-fonts-picker.md (full history incl. the removal) and features/design-system.md's Font Library section. Added 2026-08-29: hex_font_stack_primary_name()/hex_get_google_font_by_name() (name-only, case-insensitive lookup) and hex_resolve_google_font_field_selection() (pure -- decides which admin <option> to mark selected) so a hand-edited theme-options.css value with a longer fallback chain than this list's own canonical stack still shows as the right selection in the dropdown.
functions: hex_google_fonts_resource_hints() -- hooked to wp_resource_hints; adds preconnect hints when the Font Library has a selection.
hex_get_common_google_fonts() -- hardcoded name/category/stack/weights list, keyed by slug.
hex_get_google_font_by_stack( $stack ) -- reverse lookup by exact CSS font-family stack.
hex_get_font_library_selection() -- the four font_* slots currently resolved to a real Font Library entry.
hex_build_font_library_url( $selected ) -- pure; builds one combined, deduped Google Fonts CSS2 URL.
hex_enqueue_font_library() -- hooked to wp_enqueue_scripts; enqueues hex_build_font_library_url()'s result.
hex_font_stack_primary_name( $stack ) — extracts the leading font-family name from a stack string.
hex_get_google_font_by_name( $stack ) — case-insensitive lookup by leading name, regardless of fallback chain.
hex_resolve_google_font_field_selection( $value ) — pure; resolves which known stack an admin <option> should match against.

phpcs.xml.dist.purpose: WordPress Coding Standards ruleset (WordPress + PHPCompatibilityWP, testVersion 8.0-). Excludes inc/lib (vendored third-party code).

phpunit.xml.dist.purpose: PHPUnit config; bootstraps tests/bootstrap.php; suite = tests/*Test.php.

tests/bootstrap.php.purpose: WP_Mock bootstrap + plain stub functions (add_action/add_filter/wp_parse_url/__/esc_html__) + a minimal WP_Error class stub + requires every inc/*.php (incl. updater.php, child-theme.php, style-settings.php, google-fonts.php, admin/settings.php) once. Added 2026-08-29: permanent wp_json_encode()/wp_unslash() passthrough stubs (for inc/page-content.php). sanitize_text_field()/wp_strip_all_tags() were deliberately NOT given permanent stubs -- tried once, reverted, since CustomizerTest/UpdaterTest assert exact call counts against those two names via WP_Mock::userFunction(), which a permanent real definition silently bypasses.

tests/GoogleFontsTest.php.purpose: 13 tests for inc/google-fonts.php, entirely about the Font Library (the older free-text/URL-paste picker this file used to cover was removed 2026-08-29, and its tests deleted along with it) -- the resource-hints filter (leaves non-preconnect alone, adds nothing when unselected; the 'adds preconnects when selected' branch is documented as untestable in this suite -- native file I/O), the common-fonts list well-formedness (no duplicate stacks, every stack passes hex_is_safe_font_value()), stack lookup, hex_build_font_library_url() (pure -- one/multiple/deduped-family URLs), and the selection/enqueue functions' empty-state behavior. See knoladge/google-fonts-picker.md.

tests/TemplateTagsTest.php.purpose: Covers hex_should_show_title() and hex_should_show_chrome() for every template.

tests/ThemeFilesTest.php.purpose: Static checks: required files exist, page templates match hex_get_page_templates(), style.css Version == HEX_VERSION.

tests/UpdaterTest.php.purpose: Covers the updater's own logic (branch default, 'not configured' graceful paths, both sanitize callbacks) — not the third-party library itself.

tests/ChildThemeTest.php.purpose: Covers the fetch/validate functions (header parsing, non-200, missing Template:, wp_remote_get() failure, template mismatch), install's early-return validation paths, branch default, active-detection (none/any-active/live-vs-stored), 'no child theme yet' graceful paths, and the child sanitize callback — not the actual Theme_Upgrader/WP_Filesystem install or a real PucFactory build.

tests/StyleSettingsTest.php.purpose: Covers the static design-token schema (>=100 fields, every field's group is documented, every field has a real sanitize callback), naming transforms, the token-file parser, the custom-token type-guessing and schema-merge logic, value resolution (the 'no active child theme' fallback path), the CSS-file builder (incl. shadow-keyword resolution, the injection-defense skip, and the custom type), all 7 sanitize callbacks' pure accept/null-on-reject behavior, and the submitted-tokens sanitizer. Also covers fluid typography: hex_get_fluid_size_pairs() referencing only real schema keys, every fluid pair shipping with genuinely different (non-collapsing) mobile/desktop defaults, hex_build_fluid_clamp()'s interpolation formula/flat-value collapse/equal-breakpoint fallback/unsafe-input rejection, hex_build_style_tokens_css() emitting exactly one derived '--hex-{key}-size' clamp() declaration per pair (never a leftover flat value), and hex_reset_style_group_tokens() resetting only the target group's fields. The active-child-theme-with-a-real-file path is deliberately not covered here -- see knoladge/child-theme-css-token-architecture.md's Testing section for why. Added 2026-08-29: hex_sanitize_style_google_font_slot()'s accept/reject behavior, the 'google_font' sanitize-callback registration, the four Font Library schema entries, and hex_build_style_tokens_css() skipping an unset vs. emitting a set Font Library slot.

tests/AdminSettingsRenderTest.php.purpose: Covers hex_render_style_group_fields()'s accordion-vs-flat rendering (inc/admin/settings.php): a group with no 'subgroup'-tagged fields (e.g. colors) still renders one flat two-column grid with no <details> chrome; a group with multiple subgroups (e.g. alerts' Primary/Success/Warning/Danger) renders one <details> per subgroup with only the first left open, in schema order. Output-buffer (ob_start/ob_get_clean) tests, same pattern as tests/GoogleFontsTest.php's datalist test. Added 2026-08-29: hex_render_style_field() directly — the Font Library renders as its own accordion with four <select>s grouped by <optgroup> category, and an unset slot's '— Use Default —' option is selected.

assets/css/src/site-theme.css.purpose: The whole admin-configurable design-token consuming layer: @theme token block, bare h1-h6/a/body defaults, and every .hex-*/.btn/.card/.form-control/.table-styled/.alert/.badge/.nav-menu/.nav-link/.accordion/.tabs/.icon component class. Imported by front.css, compiled into assets/css/tailwind.css. Lived only in the child theme (../hexnity-wp-child) from 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-29; restored here per explicit user correction ("it should be in main theme and should load via main theme"). The child theme still keeps its own copy as an optional override layer, enqueued after this theme's. See knoladge/child-theme-css-token-architecture.md. Added 2026-08-29: .hex-font-heading/.hex-font-body/.hex-font-accent/.hex-font-mono classes (renamed same day from unprefixed names after .font-mono was found to collide with Tailwind v4's own built-in .font-mono utility) (@layer components, after .icon) — each applies font-family: var(--hex-font-{slot}, {fallback}), consuming the new Font Library schema fields. Added 2026-08-29: .hex-font-heading/.hex-font-body/.hex-font-accent/.hex-font-mono classes (@layer components, after .icon; prefixed hex- to avoid colliding with Tailwind v4's own built-in .font-mono utility) -- each applies font-family: var(--hex-font-{slot}, {fallback}). Bare body/h1-h6 in @layer base were repointed the same day from --hex-body-font-family/--hex-heading-font-family (removed fields) to --hex-font-body/--hex-font-heading (Font Library).

inc/page-content.php.purpose: The 'Page Content' JSON framework (added 2026-08-29) -- a dedicated custom DB table ({$wpdb->prefix}hex_page_content, one row per page) storing arbitrary JSON content per page, so a page template can read its own text via hex_get_page_content() and an editor can change it from a 'Page Content (JSON)' meta box on that page's own Edit Page screen (raw JSON textarea, no fixed schema -- each template defines its own key convention). No page template reads from this yet (framework-only scope this round). See features/page-content-json.md and knoladge/page-content-json-framework.md.
functions: hex_page_content_table_name() — the custom table's prefixed name.
hex_create_page_content_table() — dbDelta()-based create/upgrade, hooked to after_switch_theme.
hex_maybe_upgrade_page_content_table() — admin_init version-gated re-check for an already-active install.
hex_sanitize_page_content_value( $value ) — recursive; wp_kses_post() per string leaf.
hex_parse_submitted_page_content( $raw ) — pure; validates a raw JSON submission's shape.
hex_decode_page_content( $raw_json ) — pure; JSON string to array.
hex_encode_page_content_for_display( $content ) — pure; pretty-prints for the admin textarea, '{}' when empty.
hex_get_page_content( $page_id = null ) — the read function a template calls.
hex_get_page_content_raw( $page_id ) — pretty-printed JSON for the meta box.
hex_save_page_content( $page_id, $content ) — sanitize + upsert.
hex_delete_page_content( $page_id ) — delete a page's row.
hex_delete_page_content_on_post_delete( $post_id ) — hooked to before_delete_post.
hex_register_page_content_meta_box() / hex_render_page_content_meta_box() — the Edit Page screen UI.
hex_save_page_content_meta_box( $post_id ) — hooked to save_post_page.
hex_page_content_error_notice() — admin_notices; shows/clears an invalid-JSON error.

tests/PageContentTest.php.purpose: 33 tests for inc/page-content.php — every pure function fully covered, the DB-touching functions via a \Mockery::mock('wpdb') swapped into global $wpdb, and the meta-box save/error-notice handlers via $_POST/$_GET manipulation. hex_create_page_content_table()/hex_maybe_upgrade_page_content_table() are NOT covered — dbDelta() needs a real WP install and database, neither of which exist in this suite. See knoladge/page-content-json-framework.md.
